scope.summary: Build the coupling-graph inspector panel per Section 13.27 GUI clauses: view, disable, and author the explicit coupling links of MT-496 — every runtime-active link visible with named edges and per-edge disable, proving in the UI that NO hidden links exist (the anti-ERC stance, REQ-003, made inspectable).
acceptance_criteria: The panel renders the explicit link graph: named edges with source channel, target channel, and link function summary; edges group by owning preset.
Per-edge disable toggles take effect immediately (dialing the source no longer moves the target — verified by a live test through the panel); isolate-region state from MT-627 reflects here.
Link authoring UI creates a new named link as an operator-authored preset over independent channels; created links appear in the registry and the panel identically.

Registry parity is asserted: a test enumerates runtime-active links and panel-displayed links and requires exact set equality — any hidden link is a test failure (the anti-ERC guarantee as UI contract).
All rows/toggles carry stable author_ids for Argus steering.
scope.risk_if_missed: Coupling links become invisible plumbing again — the exact ERC-freeze opacity that makes Daz couplings undebuggable — and the founding decoupling promise of BodyKit is unverifiable by its own users.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: BodyKit GUI must expose or integrate the geometry/morph, joint, weight/rigidity, transfer, skin/material, interlink, Jobs, Problems, history, recovery, and shared-world contracts.
